title: Rafael and the Homecoming
author: Sable Vane
blurb: August Vasquez, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
